text.title: CR / BUG Tracking Decision Tree
text.summary: Defect or mutation first, then size. Routes to BUG (with or without a spec update), CR, or out to the feature lifecycle / a straight commit. Every conclusion references a rule id from 01-core-rules.xml.

decision-tree.root-question: Is the work a defect against current behaviour (something that worked, or was specified, and now does not)?

branch.question: Does the root cause expose an invariant or business rule that project-spec/ did not capture?

branch.conclusion: File a BUG (five sections, three states, `fix(BUG0NN):` prefix) AND add the rule to `project-spec/business-rules.md` / `invariants.md` in the same PR.
File a BUG: Symptom, Repro, Root cause, Fix, Regression test; `bugs/todo/` → `in-progress/` → `done/`; commit `fix(BUG0NN): …`.

branch.when: q-defect == false AND (subsystems_touched > 1 OR needs_task_breakdown == true)
branch.conclusion: Change affects multiple subsystems or requires a task breakdown — file as a feature instead.
One-line documentation tweak — straight commit, no CR.

branch.when: q-defect == false AND subsystems_touched <= 1 AND needs_task_breakdown == false
branch.conclusion: Small mutation that needs a record but no task plan — file a CR: Why, What changes, optional linked-feature; `crs/todo/` → `crs/done/`; commit `cr(CR0NN): …`.

text.example: inputs: {defect=true, root_cause='length check ran before whitespace trim', spec_has_rule=false} q-defect -> true q-reveals-rule -> true => conclusion r-revealing-bug-updates-spec: BUG019 in bugs/todo/, moves to in-progress while reproducing, fix PR carries fix(BUG019) commits + BR-051 in project-spec/business-rules.md, then bugs/done/.
